Affordable app development for iOS and Android

We build one app for iPhone and Android at the same time, at a fixed price agreed up front. An MVP starts at €3,150 and a complete app with accounts and a database at €6,750.

Our app packages

PackageIncludesFrom
Basic / MVPUp to 5 screens, ready in 3–5 weeks€3,150
Standard5–12 screens, accounts, database, push notifications, App Store and Google Play€6,750
Custom / Pro12+ screens, admin dashboard, payments and subscriptions, multiple roles€13,050

Why we cost less

We use one codebase for both platforms, proven building blocks and a lot of automation. That saves hours, and you see the savings in the price. You still own everything: after the final payment the code is yours and the app is published on your own Apple and Google accounts.

Running costs

Apple charges $99 per year and Google $25 once. Hosting for small apps is often free to $25 per month. Maintenance is optional from €85.50 per month. All of this is listed in your quote.

See it before you pay

After a short intake by email we make a free clickable concept of 1–3 screens, so you can see we can really build it.

Frequently asked questions

Do you work with clients outside the Netherlands?

Yes. We work fully online with clients worldwide, in English or Dutch. Prices are in euros.

How do I pay?

In three parts: 40% at the start, 40% when you approve the test version and 20% on delivery.

How long does it take?

A Basic app takes 3–5 weeks, a Standard app 6–10 weeks and a Custom app 10–16 weeks or more.
